notes_for_editor: Wikipedia is the only source for the tower's history. Its Go Home Lake article carries a 'needs more citations' tag and the tower sentences have no citation of their own, so they are leads, not verified facts. The article's dating is muddled: it gives the early 1970s for the Parry Sound Fire District and in the same sentence mentions the old Dept. of Lands and Forests name. The gpsnauticalcharts.com copy repeats the same wording and is not used as a separate source. The status is 'unknown' rather than 'removed': the article's past tense ('once stood') is the only hint, and no removal date or current view was found. The Firelookout.ca coordinates (45.013056, -79.883333) sit about 3 km west of the lake centre given on Wikipedia (45.00833, -79.84111), and the article's NW-side location has not been checked against them. The most recent dated record is the 1996 topographic map entry. The tower is not on either copy of the 'Ontario Fire Towers Still Standing' list. The gohomelake.ca about page does not mention the tower. Facebook group pages could not be read. No staffing, fire history, access rule or current view of the site was found. Confidence is low.
